Pregnancy is a time of increase metabolic requirements for both mother and to supply the foetus. 

↑ Oestrogen → ↑ Blood volume (40%)

- ↑RAAS → ↑ Plasma(50%)
- ↑EPO → ↑ Red cell volume (20%)

↑VR + Utero-placental Demand → ↑HR and SV → ↑ CO (45%)

↓SVR 

- Low Resistance Placental Flow
- Progesterone Smooth Muscle relaxation   

circuit 

Overall small ↓ in mAP 10%

+--------------------+---------------------+----------------------+----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
|                    | **First Trimester** | **Second Trimester** | **Third Trimester ** | **Comment **                                                    |
+====================+=====================+======================+======================+=================================================================+
| **Blood Volume**   | ↑5%                 | ↑15%                 | ↑40%                 | Overall haematocrit ↓due to greater ↑ in plasma volume then RBC |
|                    |                     |                      |                      |                                                                 |
|                    |                     |                      | ↑ RBC 30%            |                                                                 |
+--------------------+---------------------+----------------------+----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Plasma Volume ** | ↑35%                | ↑45%                 | ↑50%                 | Peaks around 36 weeks                                           |
+--------------------+---------------------+----------------------+----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **HR**             | ↑15%                | ↑25%                 | ↑30%                 |                                                                 |
+--------------------+---------------------+----------------------+----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **SV**             | ↑20                 | ↑ 25%                | ↑ 30%                |                                                                 |
+--------------------+---------------------+----------------------+----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **CO**             | ↑ 20%               | ↑25%                 | ↑45%                 | Dramatic increase in labour                                     |
+--------------------+---------------------+----------------------+----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+

Additional factors:

- Aortocaval compression: The increased CO due to increased venous return/intravascular volume can be substantially affected by the gravid uterus compressing the IVC when supine → significant ↓VR
- Increased oestrogen causes an increased plasma volume → dilutional ↓ capillary oncotic pressure, predisposing to oedema
- Relative anaemia
